content.question: What does the Hughes phenomenon describe?
options: Performance improves as features are added up to a point, after which it degrades because the model begins to fit the noise.
Performance always improves monotonically as more features are added.
Performance always decreases immediately as soon as any new feature is added.
Performance is unaffected by the number of features as long as the number of samples is large.
content.answer: Performance improves as features are added up to a point, after which it degrades because the model begins to fit the noise.
